decisions.reason: Low-pile decorative carpet is adjacent to the firm's textile/upholstery knowledge and has sustained dedicated website presence, allowing the firm to interpret early results and improve the product.
Hand-knotted wool silk carpet requires craft knowledge far from the firm's furniture manufacturing base, limiting its ability to assess and improve the product despite its website presence.
Although corner benches are core furniture, the demotion from a dedicated page to a mere mention signals weak early results that the firm can clearly interpret, making withdrawal likely.
Similar to Product A, low-pile carpet is adjacent to existing textile capabilities and maintains its own page, supporting continued learning and improvement.
Swivel shell chair is directly within the firm's core furniture competence and has consistent own-page presence, indicating strong absorptive capacity and successful early results.
